target.statement: FID score of TediGAN-B for text-to-image generation on Multi-Modal CelebA-HQ (256x256)

compute.basis: Requires training an image encoder (StyleGAN inversion) and a text encoder, plus running optimization for each test sample; GPU is necessary for reasonable runtime.

blockers: Training the image encoder and text encoder from scratch is time-consuming and requires a GPU.
The exact FID computation requires generating a large number of images (e.g., 30k) which is slow on CPU.
title: Towards Open-World Text-Guided Face Image Generation and Manipulation
